items.title: 52035_Eddie Durham oral history interview
items.q: And they was playing Harry James and all those bands.

ctx.x: And I left there and went to Glenn Miller. After we stayed up there, it was held over 16 more weeks. That's all in that paper there. And that's when I let the band go, because Mrs. Kramer come up there and somebody from the union. And he was telling me, this band -- they're not going to let you through, you sound like a white band and you're hurting the bands over here.

And they was playing Harry James and all those bands. It's a pleasure beach two miles from here, and it's paying them a lot of money and you -- let alone standing room, you couldn't get on the highway. (Unintelligible) coming from Connecticut, because Bon Bon was singing in the band, too, and that's the type of band I had with --
